name: Configuration
description: Where a run is configured from, and what the configuration decides.

scenarios.title: The nearest .sumi.json decides the base
given: a .sumi.json at the top of a project
a run starting several directories below it
scenarios.then: the base is the directory holding that .sumi.json, however deep the run started

scenarios.title: With no .sumi.json, the repository it sits in
given: a project with a .git but no .sumi.json
scenarios.then: the base is the repository root, whether .git is a directory or a gitfile

scenarios.title: With neither, where the run started
given: a directory with no .sumi.json and no .git above it
scenarios.then: the base is where the run started

scenarios.title: A .sumi.json that will not parse
given: a .sumi.json that is not readable JSON
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable

scenarios.title: Only the exceptions are listed
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be verified
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: the specification it named is not verified

scenarios.title: A specification nobody mentioned is verified
given: a .sumi.json naming one specification as not to be verified
scenarios.when: the configuration is asked about each specification
scenarios.then: a specification the file does not mention is verified
